description:
Get a specific employee by ID from Holded.

Args:
  - employee_id (string): The employee ID to retrieve (required)
  - response_format ('json' | 'markdown'): Output format (default: 'json')

Returns:
  Employee details including name, lastName, email, title, and phone.

response_format.description: Output format: 'json' for structured data or 'markdown' for human-readable

name: holded_team_get_employee
title: Get Holded Employee
